title: JSFL fl object: saveDocument, fileExists, outputPanel missing
description: In packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/runtime.ts, the fl object (~lines 1274-1322) is missing several commonly-used JSFL properties/methods: fl.saveDocument(doc, fileURL) — saves the document to disk (browser: trigger download), fl.fileExists(fileURL) — returns boolean (browser: always false since no file access), fl.outputPanel.trace(msg) — outputs text to Output panel (browser: console.log). These are needed for real-world JSFL automation scripts that do file I/O. Fix: add stubs for all three that degrade gracefully in the browser context. outputPanel.trace should also append to any visible Output/console panel in the authoring UI.
